usage: Very common spoken Cantonese. Use 放工 for the moment you leave work, or for the action of finishing work for the day.
It is informal and everyday, so it sounds natural in conversation, messages, and workplace chat.
It often pairs with time words or movement: 放工後, 放工先, 啱啱放工.
In many contexts it means more than just "finish work" in English; it can also imply "get off work" or "clock out".
